headline.purpose: The current connection state inside the primary strip.

label.purpose: Latency, expiry, usage, and quiet automatic status.

motion.name: press-feedback

motion.name: panel-transition
motion.purpose: Maximum duration for an optional page or sheet transition; never perpetual.

components.name: Connection Control
components.description: The sole connect/disconnect CTA; provider logo and decorative power badge share one circular target.

components.name: Route Chip
components.description: Compact local group navigation with one selected Signal Blue state.

components.name: Route Row
components.description: A compact selectable server row with a stable latency column and reserved state gutter.

components.name: Subscription Shelf
components.description: A fixed two-line provider summary; refresh errors replace metadata instead of adding height.

narrative.overview: MultiCore is a compact native Windows network utility. The interface is operational and calm: one unmistakable connection control, honest subscription state, and routing controls that stay on the same page. Sparse signal-grid guides provide technical character without becoming decoration. Provider identity stays subordinate to the product action.
keyCharacteristics: Dense one-page routing with stable, color-coded latency values.
Flat tonal depth, quiet borders, and no ornamental effects.
Sentence-case Russian copy and explicit unknown/error states.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Blue identifies selection, focus, and the primary action. Semantic colors communicate measured state only.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Status labels and headings use sentence case; uppercase Russian status copy is prohibited.

rules.name: The One Boundary Rule
rules.body: A surface uses one boundary mechanism at a time. Nested framing is avoided.

dos: Do keep connection, subscription, every route group, and the selected server list together on Home.
Do preserve one clear CTA and at least 44px interactive targets with visible keyboard focus.
Do display only real metrics and explicit unknown states.
Do keep provider identity subordinate to the product action.
donts: Don't add decorative logo/header stacks, duplicate Home headings, or repeated Auto explanations.
Don't add card soup, fake charts, invented latency, raw YAML/JSON, or duplicated engine switches.
Don't use emoji as interface chrome; route flags are allowed because they are data.
Don't expose controls before a real backend action exists.
